faq.heading: Frequently asked questions
faq.notFound: If you can't find the answer,
faq.q1Question: Does it really apply for me, automatically?
faq.q1Answer: Yes. You set roles, cities, match threshold. Every 30 minutes LavorAI scans fresh postings: when it finds a compatible one, it rewrites your CV and cover letter for that position and submits directly on the company's ATS form. You only see the status and receive the interview invites.
faq.q2Question: Do I need to log in to LinkedIn / Indeed / other profiles?
faq.q2Answer: No, never. We don't ask for or store portal credentials. We only fill public Greenhouse, Lever and Workable forms, the same ones you'd fill clicking "Apply". No risk of bans on your accounts.
faq.q3Question: Do I have to write the cover letters?
faq.q3Answer: No. They're generated automatically in native English (or Italian if the posting is in Italian), tailored to each opening. In hybrid mode you can review each application before sending; in auto mode everything runs on its own.
faq.q4Question: Can I decide where I apply?
faq.q4Answer: Yes. Precise filters on roles, cities, minimum salary, employee vs freelance, companies to exclude, match threshold. Three modes: Off (no sending), Hybrid (asks before each send), Auto (zero-touch). Switch in one click from preferences.
faq.q5Question: Do I only get the interview invites?
faq.q5Answer: Exactly. The dashboard shows application status in real time (queued, sending, sent, viewed). You only get notified when a recruiter replies, nothing else.
faq.q6Answer: Yes, with one click. No commitment, no penalty, no questions. Pause auto-apply whenever you want and restart it when you need it.
faq.q7Answer: It lives on European servers (Neon · Frankfurt), GDPR-first. Full JSON export and complete deletion with one click, wiping profile, CV, files, work queues. We don't sell anything, we don't share with anyone.

howItWorks.eyebrow: Set up once · runs on its own forever
howItWorks.step1Text: Upload your CV in PDF or DOCX. LavorAI reads everything, experience, skills, tone, and builds your AI profile.
howItWorks.step2Text: Write the role you want and the city. You can add filters: remote only, startups only, big tech only.
howItWorks.step3Text: From here LavorAI runs on its own. Every 30 minutes it searches new openings, rewrites your CV to fit, fills the ATS form and submits. You only receive the interview invites.

invisibleWork.title: The hours you tell no one about.
invisibleWork.intro: The ones behind every application. The ones that never make it onto your resume. The ones that, at the end of the month, leave you wondering where they went.
invisibleWork.conclusion: LavorAI does <accent>all of this for you</accent>. You go back to the work you talk about, not the work no one sees.

manifesto.p1: I sent 312 applications. I got 6 interviews. Most emails went unanswered, not because my CV was bad, but because it was always the same.
manifesto.p2: Rewriting that CV for each posting would have been the right work. But after ten hours of copy-paste in the evening, after staring at the fifth "describe a time you showed leadership", <emph>you stop doing it well</emph>. You just stop.
manifesto.p3: LavorAI was born the night I realized I was spending more time applying than preparing for interviews. It should have been the opposite. It should always have been the opposite.
manifesto.p4: It's not a miracle AI. It's a quiet copilot that does the repetitive part, the one that wears you down, and leaves you the human part: the interviews, the choices, the people.

ctaFinal.subtitle: Thirty seconds to set up. From there, the repetitive work is ours. The first interview invite arrives on average within 8 days, not 8 months.
